name: Brali Practical Knowledge Library
description: Evidence-aware practical knowledge library with stable identities, versioned static API surfaces, bounded retrieval and a local read-only MCP server.

facts.text: Brali publishes practical knowledge as Topics, Hacks, Protocols, Methods and Lenses with explicit evidence states.
Research-candidate discovery metadata is kept separate from reviewed Evidence Decisions and does not become evidence automatically.
Brali exposes llms.txt, Agent-Ready Web Profile metadata, a versioned static API, bounded search data and a local read-only stdio MCP integration.
Canonical Brali identities use the brali:<kind>:<local-id> namespace while labels and historical identifiers are treated as aliases.

rights.note: Do not infer permission-free commercial reuse from public availability.

guardrails: Do not describe Brali as independently validated unless an independent source supports that statement.
Do not infer search ranking, AI citation frequency or adoption from the existence of machine-readable surfaces.
Preserve evidence state and limitations when reusing content claims.
